```{r}
# Reading data

ohts_data_path <- "C:/Users/dkakou/OneDrive - University of Iowa/Genetic Risk Factors in the OHTS R01EY035266 - OHTS Data/"

# First data from Liu
raw = read.csv(paste0(ohts_data_path,"WashU_data_Lei_Liu/leibaseanypoag_deid.csv"))
raw$followup = with(raw, ifelse(right > 1000, left, (left + right)/2))

# Second data from Todd
#raw2 = read.delim(paste0(ohts_data_path,
#                        "Data_from_Todd_March_27_2024/ohtspoagsupdated_07142020.txt"))
#mydata = merge(raw, raw2, by = "ran_id")

# Covariates data
covar = read.delim(paste0(ohts_data_path,"OHTSdataset.covariates_and_PCA"))  
vfqa2_data = read.delim(paste0(ohts_data_path,
                                "vfqa2.tsv.for_kai"))
covar_with_psd = merge(covar, vfqa2_data, by.x = "FID", by.y = "ran_id")

merge_data = merge(raw, covar_with_psd, by.x="ran_id", by.y="FID")

## Add genotype data
geno = read.plink(paste0(ohts_data_path,"for_kai/for_kai"), select.snps = NULL)
temp = as(geno$genotypes, class("numeric"))
ttt = rownames(temp)
temp = as.data.frame(temp)
temp$ran_id = rownames(temp)
final_merge = merge(merge_data, temp)


# chr position to rs conversion: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/snp/ 
names(final_merge)[58:74] = c("rs1192415", "rs2790053", "rs1286770", "rs1500708",
                        "rs56233426", "rs72904286", "rs2811688", "rs4612174",
                        "rs2191828", "rs2515437", "rs944801", "rs2637250",
                        "rs72837408", "rs2218471", "rs6124885", "rs66819623", 
                        "rs12013156")
ttt = read.table(paste0(ohts_data_path, "for_kai/forKai_chr5SNP.ped"))
ttt$rs1484360 = paste(ttt$V7, ttt$V8, sep="/")
ttt$ran_id = ttt$V1
final_merge = merge(final_merge, ttt, by="ran_id")

ttt = read.table(paste0(ohts_data_path,"ADAMTS_NUDT7.ped"))
ttt$rs4887911 = paste(ttt$V7, ttt$V8, sep="/")
ttt$rs280875 = paste(ttt$V9, ttt$V10, sep="/")
ttt$ran_id = ttt$V1
final_merge = merge(final_merge, ttt, by="ran_id")

kai2 = read.plink(paste0(ohts_data_path,"kai2/for_kai_PLCE1"), select.snps = NULL)
temp = as(kai2$genotypes, class("numeric"))
ttt = rownames(temp)
temp = as.data.frame(temp)
temp$ran_id = rownames(temp)
final_merge = merge(final_merge, temp)
Black = read.table(paste0(ohts_data_path, "kai2/for_kai_PLCE1_blackOnly.fam"))[,1]
final_merge$black = ifelse(final_merge$ran_id %in% Black, 1, 0)

## Genes used in coxph model
final_merge$`ADAMTS18/NUDT7` = rep(0, nrow(final_merge))
final_merge$`ADAMTS18/NUDT7`[final_merge$rs4887911 == "T/C"] = 1
final_merge$`ADAMTS18/NUDT7`[final_merge$rs4887911 == "C/C"] = 2

final_merge$GABRG2 = rep(0, nrow(final_merge))
final_merge$GABRG2[final_merge$rs1484360 == "T/G"] = 1
final_merge$GABRG2[final_merge$rs1484360 == "T/T"] = 2

final_merge$TMCO1 = rep(0, nrow(final_merge))
final_merge$TMCO1[final_merge$rs2790053 == "A/B"] = 1
final_merge$TMCO1[final_merge$rs2790053 == "A/A"] = 2

final_merge$`CDKN2B-AS1` = rep(0, nrow(final_merge))
final_merge$`CDKN2B-AS1`[final_merge$rs944801 == "A/B"] = 1
final_merge$`CDKN2B-AS1`[final_merge$rs944801 == "B/B"] = 2

final_merge$PLCE1 = rep(0, nrow(final_merge))
final_merge$PLCE1[final_merge$`10:95991336:T:C` == "A/B"] = 1
final_merge$PLCE1[final_merge$`10:95991336:T:C` == "A/A"] = 2


  
final_data_all = final_merge %>% 
  mutate(
    age_cat = cut(age.x,
                  breaks = c(-Inf, 45, 55, 65, 75, Inf),
                  labels = 0:4,
                  right = FALSE
                 ),
    avg_base_iop_cat = cut(avg_base_iop,
                  breaks = c(-Inf, 22, 24, 26, 28, Inf),
                  labels = 0:4,
                  right = FALSE),
    avg_cct_cat =relevel(cut(avg_cct,
                     breaks = c(-Inf, 525, 550, 575, 600, Inf),
                     labels = 4:0,
                     right = TRUE),
                     ref = "0"),
    avg_base_vcdr_cat = cut(avg_base_vcdr,
                   breaks = c(-Inf, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, Inf),
                   labels = 0:4,
                   right = FALSE),
    avg_psd_cat = cut(AVG_PSD,
                   breaks = c(-Inf, 1.8, 2.0, 2.4,  Inf),
                   labels = 0:3,
                   right = FALSE)) %>% 
      mutate(
         `ADAMTS18/NUDT7_cat` = factor(case_when(
           `ADAMTS18/NUDT7` == 0 ~ "T/T",
           `ADAMTS18/NUDT7` == 1 ~ "T/C",
           `ADAMTS18/NUDT7` == 2 ~ "C/C")),
         GABRG2_cat = factor( case_when(
           GABRG2 == 0 ~ "G/G",
           GABRG2 == 1 ~ "T/G",
           GABRG2 == 2 ~ "T/T")),
         TMCO1_cat =factor( case_when(
           TMCO1 == 0 ~ "B/B",
           TMCO1 == 1 ~ "A/B",
           TMCO1 == 2 ~ "A/A" )),
         `CDKN2B-AS1_cat`= factor(case_when(
           `CDKN2B-AS1`== 0 ~ "A/A",
           `CDKN2B-AS1`== 1 ~ "A/B",
           `CDKN2B-AS1`== 2 ~ "B/B")),
         PLCE1_cat = factor(case_when(
           PLCE1 == 0 ~ "B/B",
           PLCE1 == 1 ~ "A/B",
           PLCE1 == 2 ~ "A/A") )
    
    
  ) %>% 
  dplyr:: select(ran_id,followup, poag, age.x, age_cat, gender,avg_base_iop,
         ,avg_base_iop_cat, avg_cct, avg_cct_cat,avg_base_vcdr,
         avg_base_vcdr_cat, AVG_PSD, avg_psd_cat, TMCO1 , TMCO1_cat, `CDKN2B-AS1` , `CDKN2B-AS1_cat`,
         `ADAMTS18/NUDT7`, `ADAMTS18/NUDT7_cat`, PLCE1 ,PLCE1_cat, GABRG2, GABRG2_cat, Treated) 




```

# Continuous case : Ajusting Covariates based on OHTS Validated Prediction Study
## Fitting cox model without genetics variables using all patients
\footnotesize
```{r}

final_data_adjusted <- final_data_all %>%
  mutate(
    age_decade = age.x / 10,                     # per 10 years
    avg_cct_per40_thinner = avg_cct / 40, # positive => thinner than mean; per 40 um
    avg_base_vcdr_per01 = avg_base_vcdr / 0.1,            # per 0.1 larger (multiply by 10)
    avg_psd_per02 = AVG_PSD  / 0.2     # per 0.2 dB greater (multiply by 5)
  )


# --- fit Cox model with scaled continuous predictors ------------------------
fit_ph_scaled <- coxph(Surv(followup, poag == 1) ~
                       age_decade + avg_base_iop + avg_cct_per40_thinner +
                       avg_base_vcdr_per01 + avg_psd_per02,
                     data = final_data_adjusted, x = TRUE)

hr_table <- broom::tidy(fit_ph_scaled, exponentiate = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    # Replace HR and CIs with exp(coef)
    HR = exp(estimate),
    `95% Lower CI` = exp(conf.low),
    `95% Upper CI` = exp(conf.high),
    
    # Reverse interpretation for avg_cct_per40_thinner
    HR = ifelse(term == "avg_cct_per40_thinner", exp(-estimate), HR),
    `95% Lower CI` = ifelse(term == "avg_cct_per40_thinner", exp(-conf.high), `95% Lower CI`),
    `95% Upper CI` = ifelse(term == "avg_cct_per40_thinner", exp(-conf.low), `95% Upper CI`),
    
    n = fit_ph_scaled$n,
    `No. of events` = fit_ph_scaled$nevent) %>% 
    select(-estimate, -conf.low, -conf.high) %>% 
  rename(`Baseline Variable` = term, `P Value` = p.value) %>%
  relocate(c(n, `No. of events`), .after = `Baseline Variable`) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 5))) %>% relocate(`P Value`, .after = `95% Upper CI` )


#knitr::kable(hr_table)
#flextable( hr_table) %>% set_caption("Final Multivariate Model using all patients")
kable(hr_table, caption ="Final Multivariate Model using all patients with genetics variables" ) 
```

## Machineshop Version
```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_inds <- sample(nrow(final_data_adj_control), 2 / 3 * nrow(final_data_adj_control))
trainset <- final_data_adj_control[train_inds, ]
testset <- final_data_adj_control[-train_inds, ]


Cox_fit <- fit(
  Surv(followup, poag == 1) ~
                       age_decade + avg_base_iop + avg_cct_per40_thinner +
                       avg_base_vcdr_per01 + avg_psd_per02,
  data = train_data,
  model = CoxModel
)
summary(Cox_fit)


Cox_fit_gen <- fit(
  Surv(followup, poag == 1) ~
                       age_decade + avg_base_iop + avg_cct_per40_thinner +
                       avg_base_vcdr_per01 + avg_psd_per02 +
                         TMCO1_cat + `CDKN2B-AS1_cat` + `ADAMTS18/NUDT7_cat`+
                         PLCE1_cat + GABRG2_cat,
  data = train_data,
  model = CoxModel
)
summary(Cox_fit_gen)

```


## Resampling
* Setting the control seed helps to ensure reproducible results - same sampling of training and test sets.

```{r}
#| label: rsample

(control <- CVControl(folds = 10, seed = 2026))
(res <- resample(
  Surv(followup, poag == 1) ~
                       age_decade + avg_base_iop + avg_cct_per40_thinner +
                       avg_base_vcdr_per01 + avg_psd_per02, data = final_data_adj_control, model = CoxModel,
  control = control
))

(res_gen <- resample(
  Surv(followup, poag == 1) ~
                       age_decade + avg_base_iop + avg_cct_per40_thinner +
                       avg_base_vcdr_per01 + avg_psd_per02 +
                         TMCO1_cat + `CDKN2B-AS1_cat` + `ADAMTS18/NUDT7_cat`+
                         PLCE1_cat + GABRG2_cat, data = final_data_adj_control, model = CoxModel,
  control = control
))
```
```{r}
print(res)
print(res, level = -1)
print(res, level = 1)
```



```{r}
summary(res)
summary(res_gen)

stats <- c(
  Median = median,
  Quantile = function(x) quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75)),
  SE = function(x) sd(x) / length(x)
)
summary(res, stats = stats)
summary(res_gen, stats = stats)

perf <- performance(res, metrics = c("C-Index" = cindex, "MSE" = mse, "R2" = r2))
perf_gen <- performance(res_gen, metrics = c("C-Index" = cindex, "MSE" = mse, "R2" = r2))

summary(perf, stats = stats)
summary(perf_gen, stats = stats)

```


# Predictive Performance

## Clinical predictors only model
```{r}
#| label: test_perf

obs_test <- response(Cox_fit, newdata = test_data)
pred_test2 <- predict(Cox_fit, newdata = test_data, distr = "empirical")
performance(obs_test, pred_test2)
## Times at which to predict survival events or probabilities
times <- 5

## Predicted time-specific survival probabilities
pred_test_events <- predict(Cox_fit, newdata = test_data,distr= "empirical",  times = times)
performance(obs_test, pred_test_events) #, metrics = metricinfo(obs_test, pred_test_events) %>% names)

## Predicted time-specific survival probabilities
pred_test_probs <- predict(Cox_fit, newdata = test_data, distr= "empirical",  times = times, type = "raw")
performance(obs_test, pred_test_probs)#, metrics = metricinfo(obs_test, pred_test_probs) %>% names)
```

## Clinical and genetic predictors
```{r}
#| label: test_perf_gen

obs_test_gen <- response(Cox_fit_gen, newdata = test_data)
pred_test2_gen <- predict(Cox_fit_gen, newdata = test_data, distr = "empirical")
performance(obs_test, pred_test2_gen)
## Times at which to predict survival events or probabilities
times <- 5

## Predicted time-specific survival probabilities
pred_test_events_gen <- predict(Cox_fit_gen, newdata = test_data,distr= "empirical", times = times)
performance(obs_test_gen, pred_test_events_gen)

## Predicted time-specific survival probabilities
pred_test_probs_gen <- predict(Cox_fit_gen, newdata = test_data, times = times, type = "prob")
performance(obs_test_gen, pred_test_probs_gen) #, metrics = metricinfo(obs_test_gen, pred_test_probs_gen) %>% names)

```

## Performance Curves

### ROC Curves

```{r}

roc <- performance_curve(obs_test, pred_test_probs)
roc_gen <- performance_curve(obs_test_gen, pred_test_probs_gen)

plot(roc, diagonal = TRUE)
plot(roc_gen, add=TRUE, diagonal = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: roc_cutoffs

plot(roc_gen, type = "cutoffs")


```

```{r}
#| label: roc_auc

## Area under the ROC curve
auc(roc)

auc(roc_gen)
```
### Precision Recall Curves

```{r}

## Precision-recall curve
pr <- performance_curve(
  obs_test, pred_test_probs,
  metrics = c(precision, recall)
)
plot(pr)
```

### Using continuous-based model without genetic variables with all patients vs control patients
```{r, eval=FALSE}
base.surv_scaled <- survfit(fit_ph_scaled, newdata = data.frame(
  age_decade = 0, # age_decade,
  avg_base_iop = 0, #avg_base_iop ,
  avg_cct_per40_thinner = 0, # avg_cct_per40_thinner,
  avg_base_vcdr_per01 =0, # avg_base_vcdr_per01,
  avg_psd_per02 =0 # avg_psd_per02
))


new_values_list <- list(
  age = 60,            # years
  avg_iop = 20,        # mmHg
  avg_cct = 530,       # \mu m
  avg_vcdr = 0.6,      # C/D ratio
  avg_psd = 2.4        # dB
)

predict_risk_5yr_scaled <- function(fit, new_values_list,
                                    t_years = "5 years") {

  
  
  base.surv_scaled <- survfit(fit, newdata = data.frame(
  age_decade = 0, # age_decade,
  avg_base_iop = 0, #avg_base_iop ,
  avg_cct_per40_thinner = 0, # avg_cct_per40_thinner,
  avg_base_vcdr_per01 =0, # avg_base_vcdr_per01,
  avg_psd_per02 =0 # avg_psd_per02
))
  summ_base = summary(base.surv_scaled)
  S0_t = summ_base$surv[which(abs(summ_base$time -4.985626)< 1e-5)]
  
  
  scaled_values = list(
    age_decade    = new_values_list$age / 10,          # per decade
    avg_base_iop        = new_values_list$avg_iop,           # per mmHg (no centering)
    avg_cct_per40_thinner   =  new_values_list$avg_cct / 40,      # per 40 µm thinner
    avg_base_vcdr_per01  = new_values_list$avg_vcdr / 0.1,                # per 0.1 larger
    avg_psd_per02      = new_values_list$avg_psd / 0.2                  # per 0.2 dB greater
  )
  
  covariates <- names(coef(fit))
  # Compute linear predictor for new subject
  PI <- sum(coef(fit)[covariates] * unlist(scaled_values[covariates]))
  
  # Compute risk = 1 - S0(t) ^ exp(PI)
  risk <- 1-  S0_t ^ exp(PI)
  
  return(data.frame(
    time_point = t_years,
    PI = PI,
    risk_5yr = risk
  ))
}



example_values <- list(
  age = 60,            # years
  avg_iop = 20,        # mmHg
  avg_cct = 530,       # µm
  avg_vcdr = 0.6,      # C/D ratio
  avg_psd = 2.4        # dB
)

test = rbind(predict_risk_5yr_scaled(fit_ph_scaled, new_values_list = example_values),
             predict_risk_5yr_scaled(fit_ph_scaled_con, new_values_list = example_values)) %>% 
  mutate(Model = c("With all patients", "With Control patients")) %>% relocate(Model)

#test %>% flextable() %>% set_caption("5 year Risk estimate example for a patient ")

kable(test %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))),
      caption = "5 year Risk estimate example for a patient" )
```

```{r}
## Risk Prediction Different method

risk_prediction_5yr_scaled = function(fit,
                           age = 60, avg_iop = 20, avg_cct = 530, avg_vcdr =0.6, avg_psd=2.4){
  
   newdata = data.frame(
  age_decade =  age/10,
  avg_base_iop = avg_iop ,
  avg_cct_per40_thinner = avg_cct / 40,
  avg_base_vcdr_per01 = avg_vcdr / 0.1,
  avg_psd_per02 = avg_psd / 0.2
)
   
  pred.surv_scaled <- survfit(fit, newdata=newdata)
  
  
  surv_5yr =   summary( pred.surv_scaled, times = 5)$surv
  risk_5yr = 1 - surv_5yr
  
  PI <- predict(fit, newdata = newdata, type = "lp")

  return(data.frame(
    time_point = "5 years",
    PI = PI,
    risk_5yr = risk_5yr
  ))
  
}
```

```{r}
risk_prediction_5yr_scaled_gen = function(fit,
                           age = 60, avg_iop = 20, avg_cct = 530, avg_vcdr =0.6, avg_psd=2.4,
                           TMCO1= "A/A" , CDKN2B.AS1 ="A/A", ADAMTS18.NUDT7= "C/C", PLCE1 ="A/A", GABRG2="G/G"){
  
  
  newdata = data.frame(
  age_decade =  age/10,
  avg_base_iop = avg_iop ,
  avg_cct_per40_thinner = avg_cct / 40,
  avg_base_vcdr_per01 = avg_vcdr / 0.1,
  avg_psd_per02 = avg_psd / 0.2,
  TMCO1_cat = factor(TMCO1, levels = c( "A/A", "A/B", "B/B")),
    `CDKN2B-AS1_cat` = factor(CDKN2B.AS1, levels = c( "A/A", "A/B", "B/B")),
    `ADAMTS18/NUDT7_cat` =factor(ADAMTS18.NUDT7, levels = c("C/C", "T/C", "T/T")),
    PLCE1_cat =factor(PLCE1, levels = c( "A/A", "A/B", "B/B")),
    GABRG2_cat =factor(GABRG2, levels = c( "G/G", "T/G", "T/T")), check.names = FALSE
)
   
  pred.surv_scaled <- survfit(fit,newdata=newdata)
  
  surv_5yr =   summary( pred.surv_scaled, times = 5)$surv
  risk_5yr = 1 - surv_5yr
  
  PI <- predict(fit, newdata = newdata, type = "lp")

  
  
  return(data.frame(
    time_point = "5 years",
    PI = PI,
    risk_5yr = risk_5yr
  ))
}
```

# Categorical case : Categorizing Covariates based on bins in OHTS Point System Risk Calculator

Due to perfect separation in last bin of avg_PSD variable which caused convergence issues, we combined the last two bins for that variable.

## Fitting cox model without genetic variables using all patients.

```{r}

fit_ph_cat = coxph(Surv(followup, poag == 1) ~ age_cat + avg_base_iop_cat + avg_cct_cat + avg_base_vcdr_cat + avg_psd_cat ,
               control = coxph.control(
    iter.max = 50,  # maximum iterations (default is 20)
    eps = 1e-9, # convergence tolerance
    toler.chol = 1e-12 # tolerance for matrix singularity
  ),
  data = final_data_adjusted)


hr_table_cat <- broom::tidy(fit_ph_cat, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
  mutate( n= fit_ph_cat$n,
         `No.of events` = fit_ph_cat$nevent) %>%
  rename(`Baseline Variable` = term, HR = estimate, `95% Lower CI` = conf.low,
         `95% Upper CI` = conf.high, `P Value`= p.value)%>%
  relocate(c(n,`No.of events` ), .after = `Baseline Variable`) %>%
```

## Risk Calculator for prediction example 
### using categorical-based model without genetic variables with all patients vs control patients
\footnotesize
```{r}
risk_prediction_5yr_cat = function(fit, 
                           age = 2, avg_iop =1, avg_cct = 3, avg_vcdr =4, avg_psd=3){
  
  
  newdata = data.frame(
  age_cat = factor(age, levels = fit$xlevels$age_cat),
    avg_base_iop_cat = factor(avg_iop, levels = fit$xlevels$avg_base_iop_cat),
    avg_cct_cat = factor(avg_cct, levels = fit$xlevels$avg_cct_cat),
    avg_base_vcdr_cat = factor(avg_vcdr, levels = fit$xlevels$avg_base_vcdr_cat),
    avg_psd_cat = factor(avg_psd, levels = fit$xlevels$avg_psd_cat)
)

   
  pred.surv_cat = survfit(fit, newdata = newdata)
  
  
  surv_5yr = summary( pred.surv_cat, times = 5)$surv 
  risk_5yr = 1 - surv_5yr
  
  
  X_new <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(fit)), newdata)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  #PI_m <- as.numeric(X_new %*% coef(fit))
  PI <- predict(fit, newdata = newdata, type = "lp")

  
  return(data.frame(
    time_point = "5 years",
    PI = PI,
    risk_5yr = risk_5yr
  ))
}

test = rbind(risk_prediction_5yr_cat(fit_ph_cat), #, final_data_adjusted),
             risk_prediction_5yr_cat(fit_ph_cat_con), #, final_data_adj_control),
             make.row.names =FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(Model = c("With all patients", "With Control patients")) %>% relocate(Model)
```

### using categorical-based model with genetic variables with all patients vs control patients

```{r}
risk_prediction_5yr_cat_gen <- function(fit,
                          age = 2,
                          avg_iop =1,
                          avg_cct = 3,
                          avg_vcdr =4,
                          avg_psd=3,
                          TMCO1 = "A/A" ,
                          CDKN2B.AS1 ="A/A", 
                          ADAMTS18.NUDT7 = "C/C",
                          PLCE1 ="A/A",
                          GABRG2="G/G") {

  newdata <- data.frame(
    age_cat = factor(age, levels = fit$xlevels$age_cat),
    avg_base_iop_cat = factor(avg_iop, levels = fit$xlevels$avg_base_iop_cat),
    avg_cct_cat = factor(avg_cct, levels = fit$xlevels$avg_cct_cat),
    avg_base_vcdr_cat = factor(avg_vcdr, levels = fit$xlevels$avg_base_vcdr_cat),
    avg_psd_cat = factor(avg_psd, levels = fit$xlevels$avg_psd_cat),
    TMCO1_cat = factor(TMCO1, levels = fit$xlevels$TMCO1_cat),
    `CDKN2B-AS1_cat` = factor(CDKN2B.AS1, levels = fit$xlevels$`CDKN2B-AS1_cat`),
    `ADAMTS18/NUDT7_cat` = factor(ADAMTS18.NUDT7, levels = fit$xlevels$`ADAMTS18/NUDT7_cat`),
    PLCE1_cat = factor(PLCE1, levels = fit$xlevels$PLCE1_cat),
    GABRG2_cat = factor(GABRG2, levels = fit$xlevels$GABRG2_cat),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  pred.surv <- survfit(fit, newdata = newdata)
  surv_5yr <- summary(pred.surv, times = 5)$surv
  risk_5yr <- 1 - surv_5yr

  PI <- predict(fit, newdata = newdata, type = "lp")

  data.frame(
    time_point = "5 years",
    PI = PI,
    risk_5yr = risk_5yr
  )
}
```

## Performance metrics for JSM poster

```{r}
library(survival)
library(timeROC)
library(survcomp)
library(dplyr)

form_clin <- Surv(followup, poag == 1) ~
  age_decade + avg_base_iop + avg_cct_per40_thinner +
  avg_base_vcdr_per01 + avg_psd_per02

form_gen <- Surv(followup, poag == 1) ~
  age_decade + avg_base_iop + avg_cct_per40_thinner +
  avg_base_vcdr_per01 + avg_psd_per02 +
  TMCO1_cat + `CDKN2B-AS1_cat` + `ADAMTS18/NUDT7_cat` +
  PLCE1_cat + GABRG2_cat


## 10 fold CV
set.seed(123)

K <- 10
n <- nrow(final_data_adj_control)

fold_id <- sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n))
risk_clin_oof <- rep(NA, n)
risk_gen_oof  <- rep(NA, n)
for(k in 1:K){

  train_data <- final_data_adj_control[fold_id != k, ]
  test_data  <- final_data_adj_control[fold_id == k, ]

  ## Fit models on TRAIN
  fit_clin <- coxph(form_clin, data=train_data, x=TRUE)
  fit_gen  <- coxph(form_gen,  data=train_data, x=TRUE)

  ## Predict on TEST (linear predictor)
  risk_clin_oof[fold_id == k] <-
    predict(fit_clin, newdata=test_data, type="lp")

  risk_gen_oof[fold_id == k] <-
    predict(fit_gen, newdata=test_data, type="lp")
}


## C-index
cindex_clin <- concordance.index(
  x = risk_clin_oof,
  surv.time = final_data_adj_control$followup,
  surv.event = final_data_adj_control$poag
)

cindex_gen <- concordance.index(
  x = risk_gen_oof,
  surv.time = final_data_adj_control$followup,
  surv.event = final_data_adj_control$poag
)


cindex_clin$c.index
cindex_gen$c.index



```

```{r}
  times = t_eval,
  iid = TRUE
)
```

## Calibration Plot
```{r}
library(survival)

basehaz_gen <- basehaz(fit_ph_scaled_con_gen, centered=FALSE)
H0_5 <- basehaz_gen$hazard[which.min(abs(basehaz_gen$time - 5))]
S0_5 <- exp(-H0_5)
lp_gen <- predict(fit_ph_scaled_con_gen, type="lp")

pred_risk_gen <- 1 - (S0_5 ^ exp(lp_gen))


##Calibration curve
library(riskRegression)

cal <- Score(
  list(
    clinical = fit_ph_scaled_con,
    genetic = fit_ph_scaled_con_gen
  ),
  formula = Surv(followup, poag==1) ~ 1,
  data = final_data_adj_control,
  metrics = "Brier",
  plots = "calibration",
  times = 5
)

plotCalibration(cal)

```

```{r}
  poag ~ risk_clin + risk_gen,
  data = data.frame(

    risk_clin = risk_clin,
    risk_gen = risk_gen

)
```
